name: Finding Ogi
description: A veteran CAST hunter has gone missing in the Rioh Snowfield. Find him and recover his body parts.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Ren
briefing_dialog.text: We've lost contact with Ogi. He's a CAST, deployed to the Rioh snowfield three days ago.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Ren
briefing_dialog.text: His patrol channel went dark mid-route. No distress, no last transmission. Just silence.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Ren
briefing_dialog.text: We don't know what happened. Find out. Bring back what you can.
